label: Suspected Cases (2026 DRC + Uganda)
source: WHO Situation Report — DRC-Uganda Ebola, 23 May 2026
contestNote: 746 suspected cases; 85 lab-confirmed across DRC (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu) and Uganda (Kampala). Suspected count includes probable and unconfirmed deaths in conflict-inaccessible zones.
deltaNote: Rapid surge from ~246 suspected cases on May 16 to ~750 by May 23 as reporting system scaled up

label: Lab-Confirmed Cases (2026 Outbreak)
source: WHO / DRC Ministry of Health, 23 May 2026
deltaNote: 8 confirmed on May 16; 85 by May 23 including 5 imported in Kampala, Uganda

label: Suspected Deaths (2026 Outbreak)
source: WHO / DRC Ministry of Health, 23 May 2026
contestNote: 177 suspected deaths across DRC; 10 confirmed deaths (9 DRC, 1 Uganda). Suspected figure includes community deaths in inaccessible zones of Ituri. Undercount likely.

label: Case Fatality Rate (2026 BDBV)
contestNote: CFR ranges from 11.8% (10 confirmed deaths / 85 confirmed cases) to 23.7% (177 suspected deaths / 746 suspected cases). BDBV historically 25–47% CFR in prior outbreaks; suspected community deaths are likely undercounted.

label: rVSV-ZEBOV Emergency Use Ring Vaccination
source: WHO IHR Emergency Committee Temporary Recommendations, 22 May 2026
contestNote: rVSV-ZEBOV (Ervebo) licensed for Zaire ebolavirus only. Off-label/emergency ring vaccination ongoing; no human efficacy data for BDBV. ETU attacks in Ituri have disrupted vaccination supply lines. MVA-BN-Filo BDBV candidate on compassionate use.
deltaNote: CEPI fast-tracking $45M for BDBV-specific vaccine; no ETA for licensed product

label: DRC Provinces + Countries Affected
source: WHO DON603 / DRC MoH / Uganda MoH, 23 May 2026
deltaNote: Ituri (index), Nord-Kivu incl. Goma (confirmed by ~May 19), Sud-Kivu / Bukavu (confirmed May 21). Uganda: 5 imported cases in Kampala, no local transmission. 10 additional countries assessed 'at risk.'

label: Contact Tracing Coverage (Uganda Kampala)
deltaNote: All 87 identified contacts of Uganda's first two confirmed cases under 21-day monitoring. DRC contact tracing severely impaired by ETU attacks and ~23% zone inaccessibility.
